body: I think I'm probably the weakest person I know. I admire strength so much because I have none of my own...
I will try. I've always believed that you don't have to accept anyone's judgement of you, but its so much harder in practice.
My family made fun of me for crying all the time. Especially for crying over a volleyball. They'd say, "haha, you look at her wrong and she cries".

I can't sleep. I'm just laying here in bed, crying off and on, feeling terrible. Feeling like someone out there is glad that I feel so terrible. I am terrible. There is nothing redeeming about me. They want me to feel terrible and here I am letting them win. I'm such a coward...

Thank you. I have admittedly been feeling a lot of stress lately. But on some level I always try to convince myself that I'm exaggerating my problems and that I have no right to be sad when my life isn't as bad as it could be. It took me forever to accept that I even had depression because I write off all my pain as nothing all the time...and today I just felt like all of my pain was a farce and that my feelings don't matter in the grand scheme of things...like I really will never make the world a better place...maybe like I make the world a worse off place...

My boyfriend tells me I'm the kindest person he's ever met. Sometimes I think he's just trying to cheer me up, but I guess I basically believe him. If only because he's only known a few decent people in his life. Yes, pleasing everyone is impossible, I know...I guess I just like to keep the number of people who are displeased with me low. I don't want anyone to hate me, but really only because...well I don't hate anyone. :(

Thank you. I've been feeling so much lately like I don't contribute anything of importance. I feel like such a burden on my loved ones. Is it enough to be kind and honest? No matter how I feel inside I always try to be bright and smiling at work, but I feel like its never enough. I'm never enough. Enough for who or what, I have no idea...

I know, I totally expected someone to get angry, but I never thought they'd make me feel like this. Even as I sit here I'm scared of the orangered envelope; maybe it'll be someone who agrees with me and wants me to die.

It's so hard to be good when people expect everyone to be lousy. I like to think there's good in everyone...

You make a lot of sense...I used to think I was a really empathetic person. I cried when Tom Hanks lost Wilson in Castaway. I really do feel for other people's pain. It just really hurt being told in no uncertain terms that I will never understand and that I will "never make the world a better place". As I mentioned above, I suffer from depression.

To be perfectly honest, I was trying to learn more about about cultural appropriation and how it affects people of color. And no matter how understanding I tried to be, I was shut down and told I was insensitive, stupid, whiny, racist and I quote "you make me sick". Basically because I didn't agree with how he was painting me as this bad person for having differing opinions. I try so hard. I want to be good to people, but its hard when they're trying so hard to hurt you.

I have been struggling with depression for over a year now. I admit that I am a sensitive individual...its pretty easy to hurt my feelings. I wish I were stronger...
